entities.summary: Ori Orr is an Israeli retired general and politician. During his service with the Israel Defense Forces, he headed the Central and Northern Commands. He later served as a member of the Knesset for the Labor Party between 1992 and 1999. During his tenure, He chaired the Foreign Affairs and Defence Committee (1992-1995) and served as Deputy Minister of Defence (1995-1996).
